question: Which country hosted the FIFA World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qatar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Qatar** is the **host country **for the **FIFA World Cup 2022.**
 
• The **22ⁿd FIFA World Cup**, an international football competition for national teams, was held in **2022 **and was overseen by FIFA.
 
• After a** 3-3 draw** after extra time, **Argentina defeated** the defending champion France **4-2 on penalties **to win the championship. 
 
• The **Golden Ball** went to **Argentine captain Lionel Messi**, who was chosen as the **greatest player** of the competition. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Japan **has hosted the **FIFA World Cup twice,** in **2002** with **South Korea** and in** 2012 **with **Brazil **for the FIFA Club World Cup. 
 
• **France** has hosted the FIFA World Cup once in **1998**, where they** won** the tournament on home soil. 
 
• **USA** hosted the FIFA World Cup once in **1994**, where they set a record for the **highest average attendance** in the history of the tournament.
 
• The **FIFA Women's World Cup**, which took place in **2023**, was its **ninth iteration.**
 
 
• **Australia and New Zealand **co-hosted the competition, which ran from **July 20 to August 20, 2023.**
 
• After defeating England, the defending European champions, 1-0 in the championship match,** Spain** was declared the victor.
